evidence: Thin ﬁlm depositions of RxMnyO3 with R = Y, La, Sm, Tb, Yb, and Lu were performed using a commercial ﬂow-type ALD reactor (F-120 by ASM Microchemistry Ltd.) under a pressure of 2 -3 mbar. A basic ALD cycle consisted of the following sequence: 1.5 s R(thd) 3 followed by 1.5 s purge or 2.0 s Mn(thd) 3 followed by 2.0 s purge, 1.5 s ozone, and 1.8 s purge.
